name: 终极地狱完整版
english_description: Ultimate Hell: Complete Edition (in-game banner: 'Emperor of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic), from 2002.06.2'). Part of the same six-way 'Hell'/Doing-lineage map family as this collection's hell, zjdy2008wzb, zjdyaryl, zjdyzj, and zjmudhell (the original archive was itself named hell) — its adm/single/master.lpc, logind.lpc and named.lpc are structurally near-identical to zjdy2008wzb's, and a byte-level, line-ending-normalized room-tree comparison found the shared map is roughly 67-76% identical across the family (closest to zjdy2008wzb, more diverged from the tighter zjdyaryl/zjdyzj cluster), covering the same Shaolin/Wudang/Emei/Beggars'-Sect/'Dragon Slaying'/'Blood Blade' zones. This build's own versiond.lpc (2,194 lines) is a substantially more complete build/sync daemon than zjdy2008wzb's, though it needed the same WASM socket-gutting treatment; unlike zjdy2008wzb it shipped with its log/nosave/ directory already present and correct save-permission checks in securityd.lpc, so it avoided that sibling's connection-killing bug. Deep testing found and fixed a real §7.86-shaped bug across all 43 bulletin boards (a redundant self-replace_program() call breaking BULLETIN_BOARD inheritance) plus the classic GBK-byte-range is_chinese() name-length bug shared across this whole lineage.
